commentary.text: 90+9' Alejandro Quintero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
90+8' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+2' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Carles Alena (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Nico Williams is replaced by Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao).
87' 2 - 4 What a goal that is! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a mazy run and from inside the box he beats Antonio Sivera with a delightful chip. He makes it 2:4.
84' Having seen unsporting behavior, Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) is the recipient.
84' 2 - 3 Goal! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
82' The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
80' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
76' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

74' 2 - 2 Goal! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Antonio Sivera had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:2.
73' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Andoni Gorosabel and he is replaced by Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao).
73' The game has come to an end for Ibrahim Diabate. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Carles Alena (Alaves).
68' 2 - 1 The ball from the corner slips through the box to Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) and he slots it into the bottom right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
68' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' A cross into the box from Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
65' Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
62' Here is a change. Pablo Ibanez is going off and Quique Sanchez Flores gives the last tactical orders to Ander Guevara (Alaves).
62' That will be all from Denis Suarez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jon Guridi (Alaves).
59' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
59' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
58' Jonny Otto (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
58' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
56' Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
53' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Quintero signals.
50' The attendance for today's match is 19125.
49' This is a yellow card! Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

46' 1 - 1 GOAL 1:1! Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Gomez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
46' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Inaki Williams is replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
46' Here comes a substitution. Mikel Jauregizar is given a rest as he is replaced by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Alejandro Quintero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45+2' The Alaves players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Alejandro Quintero. NO PENALTY!
45+1' Celebrations by Alaves are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
44' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Penalty awarded! Alaves will take a penalty kick.
43' An accurate cross picks out Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
41' Ernesto Valverde (Ath Bilbao) gets a yellow card, off the field.
40' 2:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
35' Denis Suarez (Alaves) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
35' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle after Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
33' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
28' Toni Martinez (Alaves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
27' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
23' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
15' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Quintero no option but to blow his whistle.
14' Denis Suarez (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
14' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
13' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
8' 1 - 0 Antonio Blanco (Alaves) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top right corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
4' Great teamplay by Alaves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' The ball is cleared after Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
